This is a '''list of staff members''' who worked on the [[Spin-off Pokémon games|spin-off]] {{wp|Fictional crossovers in video games|crossover}} game [[Pokkén Tournament]]. It was published by [[The Pokémon Company]] and developed by {{wp|Bandai Namco Games}}. All names are given in Western order. For the staff of the [[Nintendo Switch]] version, see [[Staff of Pokkén Tournament DX]].
